_note: Hand-computed expected outcome for golden-viva.csv. All 12 weeks are present per person, so the latest-week 12-week rolling window covers every week; avg12 = mean of the 12 weekly Total Copilot actions taken. habit = (>=9 of 12 weeks have >=1 action). Tier via product classify(): avg12>=20 && habit -> Power; avg12>=8 && habit -> Habitual; avg12>=1 -> Novice; avg12>0 -> Low; else Non.
